llm_description: t_bz_monitor_chart_sql表存储监控图表的SQL配置信息，用于生成客户、设备、订单等业务数据的可视化分析报告，关联HBase与业务表进行多维度数据索引管理。

columns.name: INDEX_TYPE
columns.description: INDEX_TYPE。常见值: Class Utilization Statistic, UDP Round Trip Time, Packet Loss, Storage Utilization Statistic, Firewall Connections, Packets, UDP Jitter Statistics, Udp Jitter, Process Count Statistic, HTTP Statistic

columns.name: TIME_TYPE
columns.description: TIME_TYPE。常见值: hour, fift, day, week, month, raw data
